_about: Stage 5 script. One beat = one scene. vo is spoken (display spelling; brand pronunciations live in campaign.brand.say). voice.mode: recorded (you read the lines; the built-in files engine), clone (ref = a voice in voices/), design (pick a ref first), preset (name = an engine's stock voice) or none; voice.engine overrides campaign.voice_engine. Variants replace beat B01 only, so hooks can be A/B tested on one body. recipe (mvflib/recipes.json) names what the script is built from; beats[].material cites the 00-material item ids each beat stands on (mvf material ls), the way facts cites F ids. Delete this _about when done.
value: what the viewer walks away with
